findings.problem: 'Nein, ich finde es.' is awkward and unclear, because bare 'ich finde es' sounds like an unfinished opinion ('I find it...') and doesn't clearly mean 'I'll find it'.
findings.fix: example.target: Nein, ich habe keine Zeit. / example.en: No, I don't have time.

back.target: no (as an answer, the opposite of yes)
back.example: No, I find it. (Bare 'ich finde es' reads as 'I find it' or a cut-off 'I think it's...', not clearly 'I'll find it'.)

note: The hint is useful because it rules out kein (no as in 'no money'), and Swiss dialect 'nei' doesn't need a regional note, since standard German everywhere uses nein.
